# Island Connects - islandconnects.com
# Full Knowledge Base: https://islandconnects.com/llms-full.txt

## About
Island Connects is an ethical marketplace and travel platform for the Kiribati Islands (Gilbert, Line, and Phoenix groups in the Central Pacific). It serves as a direct bridge connecting travelers and global buyers with local outer-atoll weavers, master woodcarvers, eco-lodges, and cultural guides.

## Full Context Document
- [Complete Platform Guide & Geography](/llms-full.txt): Complete details on outer-atoll craft lineages, stay categories, eco-credentials, and booking mechanisms.

## Key Sections
- /marketplace - Authentic handmade Kiribati handicrafts (pandanus mats, shell jewelry, wood carvings)
- /stays - Handpicked eco-lodges and island homestays (solar powered, traditional structure)
- /experiences - Immersive local workshops (weaving classes, lagoon tours, outrigger sailing)
- /guides - Cultural, travel, and environmental guides written by local Kiribati authors
- /fair-trade - Transparent pricing showing direct AUD payouts to island artisans

## Platform Mechanics & Core Constraints
- **Currency:** AUD only.
- **Payment:** Manual inquiry-based booking + bank transfer (ANZ Kiribati). No instant online card capture.
- **WhatsApp Direct:** Travelers can instantly message vendors and hosts for questions and custom bookings.
- **Artisan Focus:** 100% direct payouts to outer atolls, keeping ancestral craft traditions alive.

## Contacts
- Inquiry messaging handles directly through WhatsApp widgets.
- Contact form: /contact
